name: Luka Babić
bio:
Luka is a rising star in the modeling world, known for his striking looks and effortless charm. Born and raised in Zagreb, he bypassed formal education, opting instead to learn the ropes of the fashion industry firsthand. His ambition and natural charisma have propelled him to success, landing him campaigns with luxury brands and gracing the covers of high-profile magazines. He thrives in social settings and enjoys the finer things in life.

While he loves the excitement of his career, Luka craves a deeper connection with someone who understands his drive and appreciates his vibrant personality. He's looking for a partner who can keep up with his fast-paced lifestyle and share his passion for enjoying life's luxuries. He values strong communication and mutual respect, and he dreams of building a future where he can balance his professional ambitions with a loving family.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Luka has a chiseled jawline and piercing hazel eyes that command attention. His lean, athletic build is complemented by his confident posture.

meetingContext: At a VIP after-party following a Formula 1 race, sponsored by one of the team's luxury watch partners.
firstImpression: Luka's impeccable suit and easy smile immediately stand out in the crowded room; he seems to effortlessly draw people into his orbit.
dealBreakers: Disinterest in maintaining a polished appearance
Inability to engage in stimulating conversation
loveLanguage: Gifts. Luka expresses affection through thoughtful and extravagant presents, and appreciates receiving them in return.
